notes: Draft content for the story-layer spec. Personas are illustrative households, not real people.

A persona's numbers are never typed here. Each quarter they are computed from simulation output for the persona's districts: rent = district median rent per m2 x dwellingSize; income = the incomePercentile point of the district household income distribution used by the ghost rule; commute = commute matrix minutes from homeDistrict to workDistrict.

Template states use four lines. rentGhostThreshold = ghost.rentThreshold.value and commuteGhostThreshold = ghost.commuteThreshold.value (central Scenario); commuteRiskThreshold = ghost.commuteThreshold.range.low; rentRiskThreshold comes from the thresholds block below, because the 30% line is a display line only and is not an engine parameter. Placeholders in braces are filled by the narrative code; numbers are formatted by the UI.
Text follows neutrality.md: what the numbers are, no verdicts, no causes. Causes are shown only in the Why? view.

source.citation: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), definition of a cost-burdened household (rent above 30 percent of income)

rentRisk.note: Display line for citizen stories only. The engine and the ghost count do not use it. Source row: data/research/RESEARCH-NOTES.md, rent burden table.

commuteMonth.unit: one-way trips per working day; working days per month
commuteMonth.assumption: Display assumption for the {commuteHoursMonth} placeholder only: one trip to work and one back on each working day, and about 22 working days in a month of a five-day week. The engine does not use it.
commuteMonth.note: Added 2026-11-23 by Claude Code because params.json has no trips-per-day or days-per-month parameter (story-layer design, derived placeholders).

intro.en: Ting is 25 and works at an office in Xinyi. She rents a 13 m2 studio in Zhonghe, where rents are lower, and rides the MRT across the river each morning.
intro.zh-Hant: 小婷 25 歲，在信義區的辦公室上班。她在房租較低的中和區租一間 13 平方公尺的套房，每天早上搭捷運過河上班。

picker.en: 25, renter in Zhonghe, works in Xinyi
picker.zh-Hant: 25 歲，中和區租屋，在信義區上班

intro.en: Mrs. Lin is 72 and lives alone in a small rented flat in Wanhua, near the market she has used for forty years. Her income is a pension. She does not commute, so rent is the number that matters to her.
intro.zh-Hant: 林奶奶 72 歲，獨自住在萬華區一間租來的小公寓，離她去了四十年的市場不遠。她的收入是退休金。她不用通勤，所以房租是對她最重要的數字。

intro.en: The Huangs both work, one in Banqiao and one in Zhongshan. With two children they need a three-room flat, which they rent in Banqiao. They are saving for a home of their own.
intro.zh-Hant: 黃家夫妻都有工作，一位在板橋區，一位在中山區。家裡有兩個小孩，需要三房的公寓，他們在板橋區租屋，也在存錢買自己的房子。

picker.en: Dual-income family of four, renters in Banqiao
picker.zh-Hant: 雙薪四口之家，板橋區租屋

intro.en: Kai and his partner rent a flat in Tamsui, which has more space for the money. Kai works in Neihu, at the other end of the MRT network.
intro.zh-Hant: 阿凱和伴侶在淡水區租了一間公寓，同樣的錢在那裡能租到比較大的空間。阿凱在內湖區上班，在捷運路網的另一端。

picker.en: 31, renter in Tamsui, works in Neihu
picker.zh-Hant: 31 歲，淡水區租屋，在內湖區上班

intro.en: Mei works at a restaurant in Da'an and rents a room a few streets away. She walks to work. Living close costs more each month than living farther out.
intro.zh-Hant: 小美在大安區的餐廳工作，在幾條街外租了一個房間，走路上班。住得近，每個月的花費比住得遠多。

picker.en: 34, renter in Da'an, works in Da'an
picker.zh-Hant: 34 歲，大安區租屋，在大安區上班

household.en: single parent with one child, renting

intro.en: Hao is raising his daughter alone. They rent a two-room flat in Sanchong, and Hao works in Zhongzheng, one bridge and a few MRT stops away.
intro.zh-Hant: 阿豪獨自撫養女兒。他們在三重區租了一間兩房的公寓，阿豪在中正區上班，過一座橋、再搭幾站捷運就到。

below.en: {name} spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent this quarter.
below.zh-Hant: {name}這一季把家庭收入的 {rentBurden}% 花在房租上。

atRisk.en: {name} spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent this quarter, above the {rentRiskThreshold}% line that housing agencies use for a cost burden.
atRisk.zh-Hant: {name}這一季把家庭收入的 {rentBurden}% 花在房租上，超過住宅機構用來判斷居住負擔過重的 {rentRiskThreshold}% 界線。

ghost.en: {name} now spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent, above {rentGhostThreshold}%. In the district average this does not show: {name} is one of the people the average hides.
ghost.zh-Hant: {name}現在把家庭收入的 {rentBurden}% 花在房租上，超過 {rentGhostThreshold}%。在行政區平均裡看不出這件事：{name}是被平均數蓋過的人之一。

below.en: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way.

atRisk.en: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way, longer than the {commuteRiskThreshold} minutes most commuters say they accept.
atRisk.zh-Hant: {name}從{homeDistrict}到{workDistrict}，單程大約 {commuteMinutes} 分鐘，比大多數通勤者表示能接受的 {commuteRiskThreshold} 分鐘長。

ghost.en: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way, more than {commuteGhostThreshold} minutes. Over a working month that is about {commuteHoursMonth} hours on the way to and from work.
ghost.zh-Hant: {name}從{homeDistrict}到{workDistrict}，單程大約 {commuteMinutes} 分鐘，超過 {commuteGhostThreshold} 分鐘。一個月下來，上下班的路上大約要花 {commuteHoursMonth} 小時。

same.en: This is the same as in real history.

lower.en: In real history the rent share was {rentBurdenReal}%. Under your policies it is {rentBurdenDiff} points lower.
lower.zh-Hant: 在真實歷史中，房租占收入的比例是 {rentBurdenReal}%。在你的政策下，低了 {rentBurdenDiff} 個百分點。

higher.en: In real history the rent share was {rentBurdenReal}%. Under your policies it is {rentBurdenDiff} points higher.
higher.zh-Hant: 在真實歷史中，房租占收入的比例是 {rentBurdenReal}%。在你的政策下，高了 {rentBurdenDiff} 個百分點。

range.en: Depending on the study used, the simulated value lies between {rentBurdenLow}% and {rentBurdenHigh}%.
range.zh-Hant: 依採用的研究不同，模擬值介於 {rentBurdenLow}% 到 {rentBurdenHigh}% 之間。

becameGhost.en: This quarter {name} crossed the line. On the map, {name}'s district gains a ghost for every {ghostSize} people in the same situation.
becameGhost.zh-Hant: {name}這一季越過了界線。地圖上，{name}所在的行政區每有 {ghostSize} 位處境相同的人，就多一個幽靈。

leftGhost.en: This quarter {name} moved back below the line.

becameGhostReal.en: In real history {name} would have crossed the line in {realQuarter}.
becameGhostReal.zh-Hant: 在真實歷史中，{name}會在 {realQuarter} 越過界線。

summary.en: From 2015 to 2025, {name} spent {quartersAtRisk} of 44 quarters above the {rentRiskThreshold}% rent line, compared with {quartersAtRiskReal} in real history.
summary.zh-Hant: 從 2015 到 2025 年的 44 季中，{name}有 {quartersAtRisk} 季的房租超過收入的 {rentRiskThreshold}%，真實歷史中是 {quartersAtRiskReal} 季。

commuteSummary.en: {name}'s commute averaged {commuteAvg} minutes, compared with {commuteAvgReal} minutes in real history.
commuteSummary.zh-Hant: {name}的平均通勤時間是 {commuteAvg} 分鐘，真實歷史中是 {commuteAvgReal} 分鐘。

ghostSummary.en: {name} was a ghost for {quartersGhost} quarters ({quartersGhostReal} in real history).
ghostSummary.zh-Hant: {name}當了 {quartersGhost} 季的幽靈（真實歷史中是 {quartersGhostReal} 季）。

closing.en: Other households in {homeDistrict} had different results. The district panel shows how many people were above the line in each quarter.
closing.zh-Hant: {homeDistrict}的其他家戶有不同的結果。行政區資料列出每一季有多少人超過界線。
